subject: Invitation to Our Annual Company Networking Event
body: Dear Team, We are excited to invite you to our annual company networking event, which will be held on Friday, September 24th from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at the Grand Ballroom. This event will provide a great opportunity for all employees to mingle, network, and build connections within the company. There will be food, drinks, and fun activities planned for the evening. Please RSVP by September 15th. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, The Organizing Committee
